site.notes: Site chosen because provides reasonable depth of peat (>3m).

dataset.datasetnotes: Record originally compiled into Indo-Pacific Pollen Database (IPPD) by Annika Herbert, Geoff Hope and Simon Haberle, and prepared for upload to Neotoma by YOURNAME, Adrian George and Jack Williams (UW-Madison), in partnership with Suzette Flantua and HOPE project (UiB)

collectionunit.notes: Stratigraphy of the southern part of the Delegate River was determined by a Hiller Corer. Samples were taken every 10cm and placed in clean phials in the field. One moss polster was taken from a grassy woodland near Delegate.

site.sitedescription: In a sphagnum bog near Delegate River. Flows through low-forest, thicket or bog. Surrounded by tall, open forest (mostly eucalyptus)
